protocol.title: Multiplexed Proteomic Sample Preconcentration Device Using Surface-Patterned Ion-Selective Membrane
protocol.platform: PDMS microfluidic chip with surface-patterned planar Nafion ion-selective membrane (PDMS/glass)
protocol.objective: High-throughput electrokinetic protein preconcentration in PDMS microfluidic chip format using surface-patterned submicron Nafion ion-selective membrane; demonstration of parallel 10-unit array format for increased concentrated sample volume compatible with mass spectrometer interfacing

device.type: PDMS microfluidic preconcentrator with embedded planar Nafion membrane
device.layout: Dual gate design: one central sample channel flanked symmetrically by two buffer channels

membrane.material: Nafion perfluorinated ion-exchange resin (Sigma-Aldrich, 5 wt% in lower aliphatic alcohols/H2O, 15-20% water)
membrane.function: Planar ion-selective permselective junction connecting all three microchannels at channel bottom; analogous to nanochannels in prior silicon device
membrane.failure_threshold_nm: >400 (PDMS cannot seal; leakage at membrane edges compromises ion selectivity)
membrane.ion_selectivity_mechanism: Cluster network (reduced effective pore size) + sulfonate groups (increased negative charge density)

microflow_patterning.channel_geometry_um: 120 deep x 200 wide (temporary reversibly bonded PDMS)
microflow_patterning.step_1: Place 1 uL Nafion resin at reservoir; capillary force fills channel
microflow_patterning.step_2: Apply negative pressure via syringe tubing on opposite end; flush liquid resin, leaving thin residual layer on glass
microflow_patterning.step_3: Cure at 95 C for 10 min on hotplate
microflow_patterning.step_4: Remove temporary PDMS; plasma bond device PDMS on top
microflow_patterning.thickness_control: Controlled by magnitude of applied negative pressure; reproducible at constant pressure

micro_stamping.step_2: Ink PDMS microstamp with Nafion resin
micro_stamping.step_3: Transfer Nafion resin to clean pre-cleaned glass substrate (25 mm x 75 mm; cleaned with IPA + DI water)
micro_stamping.step_4: Cure at 95 C for 10 min on hotplate
micro_stamping.notes: Thickness varies with stamping pressure distribution; risk of leakage if >400 nm

bonding.method: Standard O2 plasma bonding; PDMS chip placed on top of Nafion-patterned glass
bonding.notes: Elastic PDMS conforms to rounded Nafion membrane profile at <=400 nm thickness

depletion_mode.effect: Normal field (En) depletes ions; charged molecules pushed toward V1 reservoir

concentration_mode.effect: Tangential field (Et) drives EOF along sample channel; molecules stacked in front of depletion boundary
concentration_mode.notes: Above Vdiff=25V, secondary nonlinear electrokinetics destabilize the concentrated zone

array_format.arrangement: Radial; single preconcentrators oriented toward common collection reservoir at center

nafion_resin.viscosity: Low (high water content); fills microchannel by capillary force

phosphate_buffer.use: Sample solvent and buffer channel fill

model_protein.name: beta-Phycoerythrin (beta-PE)
model_protein.supplier: Sigma-Aldrich Chemical Co., St. Louis, MO

glass_substrate.cleaning: IPA + DI water thoroughly before patterning

steps.name: Nafion membrane patterning - micro-flow patterning
steps.patterning_channel_um: 120 deep x 200 wide (temporary reversibly bonded PDMS)
steps.notes: Capillary fill then negative-pressure flush leaves thin Nafion layer on glass. Cure removes solvent and consolidates the permselective film. Encoded as self-mix + heat in BioScript (off-chip patterning abstraction).

steps.name: PDMS chip plasma bonding and post-bond bake
steps.notes: PDMS chip placed on Nafion-patterned glass; alignment not critical. Post-bond bake at 70 C for 12 h (720 min in BioScript; IR: 43200.0 SECOND) enhances bonding strength. Elastic PDMS conforms to Nafion membrane profile <=400 nm.

steps.name: Buffer channel loading
steps.channels: Both flanking buffer channels (dual gate); grounded during operation
steps.notes: Two independent buffer channel fills combined into bufferDual. Dual gate improves depletion region stability vs. single buffer channel design.

steps.name: Sample loading into center channel
steps.sample: beta-PE in 10^-2 M phosphate buffer pH 7
steps.notes: Sample loaded into central microchannel; both ends accessible for V1 and V2 electrode connections.

steps.name: Depletion mode (Phase 1)
steps.physics: Normal field (En) across Nafion membrane depletes ions in sample channel; charged beta-PE molecules pushed toward V1 reservoir; depletion region forms and stabilizes
steps.abstraction: heat at 50c encodes V1=50V operating voltage (BioScript electrical primitive not available)

steps.name: Concentration mode (Phase 2)
steps.physics: Tangential field (Et) drives EOF along sample channel toward depletion zone boundary; molecules injected by EOF stack in front of depletion region forming concentrated plug; En and Et reach equilibrium at stable plug position Y2 from Nafion membrane
steps.abstraction: heat at 25c encodes V2=25V reduced voltage; unique variable concentratedPlug avoids reassignment

steps.name: Fluorescence detection of concentrated plug

platform.photobleaching_control: Mechanical shutter (Olympus) blocks UV between acquisitions
platform.dynamic_range: Neutral density filter (Olympus) prevents CCD saturation

steps.pass_criterion: Fluorescence intensity >= 8 uM reference (>=~10^4 fold increase from 400 pM in 5 min)

performance_summary.comparison_vs_prior_pdms_device: 12x faster (prior junction gap breakdown: ~10^4 in 1 h)
performance_summary.comparison_vs_silicon_nanochannel: Concentrated volume 350x larger (200 pL vs few pL)
performance_summary.nafion_vs_nanochannels: Higher permselectivity (smaller pore size + higher sulfonate charge density); no breakdown voltage limit on PDMS vs. oxide-limited silicon

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Nafion patterning (cure 95C 10min), post-bond bake (70C 720min), buffer channel loading, sample loading, depletion mode (50C 1min abstraction), concentration mode (25C 5min abstraction), fluorescence detection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_3_f
basic_blocks.action: dispose(concentratedPlug) [drain normalized to dispose by compiler]

compiler_notes.ir_output: 4 basic blocks (BB1-BB4), 1 if/else gate, 4 CFG edges
compiler_notes.self_mix_pattern: nafionResin mixed with itself (line 11 IR); models single-reagent flow-coat step with no second reagent. Same documented pattern as warkiani_spiral_ctc_isolation.bs. Compiled without error.
compiler_notes.multi_consumption: bufferDual1[0] consumed three times (lines 16, 18, 19, 21 IR) representing continuous buffer channel presence during all three operating phases. Compiled without error.
compiler_notes.sequential_heat_calls: Two heat calls on nafionCured1[0] (95C/600s then 70C/43200s) compiled correctly; compiler permits multiple heat calls on the same live variable.
compiler_notes.voltage_abstraction: No BioScript electrical primitive; depletion mode encoded as heat at 50c (V1=50V token), concentration mode as heat at 25c (V2=25V token).
compiler_notes.drain_normalization: drain normalized to dispose in IR (expected compiler behavior)
